title: Validity by circuit evaluation
statement: For every bit string $w$, the validity indicator of $w$ equals the Boolean disjunction of two verdicts: the verdict on the pairing of $w$ with a string of $|w|$ ones, and the verdict on the pairing of the circuit-kind-swapped version of $w$ with a string of $|w|$ zeros.
